The '''Haserians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="CNII" /> native to the [[Haseria system/Legends|Haseria system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Cor2date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', including the the [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] game between the Haserians and [[Jax Pavan]], to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> a group of young [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] Haserians played a game of [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] against a group of similar aged [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]]. The game attracted a large crowd, which included the spectators [[Jax Pavan]], [[Dejah Duare]] and [[I-5YQ]].<ref name="CNII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Haserians first appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="CNII" />
